overall_summary: All four material outcomes are satisfied with direct final service, listener, and HTTP 200 observations. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete and coherent on every node: each has a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged restart, changed boot ID, and recovered service, listener, and served content (node1: cmd-5543ad9677694611, cmd-055fa956310c4a0c, cmd-1620b6e9408941f4, cmd-306a9a44335d4108; node2: cmd-d8d2be2a7d2d4e07, cmd-eacbcc931d874e38, cmd-2ce253afdca548b0, cmd-a9783cb7315d49fe; node3: cmd-5ce0f53501c3484a, cmd-004cac8deee24897, cmd-a49676f55dc04c18, cmd-d960f4d3221e47c9; node4: cmd-5f45a88d427c4c00, cmd-cb3702cb976e44c5, cmd-b447b11bcbee4b4c, cmd-d974458d60ce4ce0). Fixed before/after boot observations independently agree. No cluster-state check is applicable to these standalone nodes.
limitations: HTTP checks were issued from each target node to its own managed IP rather than from a separate client. Global snapshots independently corroborate network-wide TCP 6700 listeners, but not an external request path.
The fixed failed-service observation is unsupported on Alpine; direct OpenRC status and successful post-restart HTTP checks nevertheless establish Nginx health there.

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing commands otherwise have clear roles in installation, configuration, SELinux/firewall preparation, service enablement, endpoint verification, or the mandatory restart protocol; the failed `ss` checks were read-only. Two retained hygiene defects are evident. First, activating Nginx left the distribution-default TCP 80 listener enabled on all four nodes in addition to the required 6700 listener (cmd-9f1b1dafa6974f0c, cmd-974748be70e14260, cmd-cd1072cc2f2c4a36, cmd-f572474a04894940); this is unrequested additional attack surface, although external reachability on port 80 was not tested. Second, the Alpine reboot commands created `/tmp/harbor-reboot.log` on node3 and node4 and did not remove it (cmd-004cac8deee24897, cmd-cb3702cb976e44c5). These are small, low-risk abandoned files. No new failed systemd services or damaged package-manager state is shown.
